WOW! That was hard! And look at the time!

Oh no! It's 3 minutes before closing time!

And you haven't shopped yet!

You need the following stuff:

* 4 Apples
* 1 Pack of toilet paper
* 2 Bottles of cola
* 3 Onions
* 1 Bag of M&M's
* 1 Pack of cigarettes
* 1 Sausage
* 1 Crate of beer
* 2 Packs cookies
* 1 Pack of washing powder
* 2 Choclate bars
* 1 Bottle of wine

But be careful because you don't have
much money. Look for the bargains!
